frontMatter.yaml:
# Milestone 2: M1 + concurrent writer (reliable DB).
# Adds: fairTaskWriter.writeBatch (pin ack levels -> pick levels -> write ->
# merge -> unpin), mergeWrite mode with the bypass/eviction logic,
# newlyWrittenTasks buffering when a write races a pending read, and the
# ack-level pinning rules in ackLevelPinnedLocked/advanceAckLevelLocked.
#
# The DB starts empty; every task is created by the writer, at any unused
# level above the current (pinned) ack level — levels are NOT monotonic
# across writes, that's the point of the fair queue.
options:
  max_actions: 100
  max_concurrent_actions: 2
  crash_on_yield: false
deadlock_detection: false   # "all written tasks acked" is a valid final state
liveness: strict
